DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH:
Ay there! You look like a rich missy.
You must work hard at your job to be paid this much, eh?
Tlnote: Missy here he says to necrobinder too, so use the same word.
DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: Continue
Haha... Yes, I'm very hardworking!
Tlnote: She's nervous here because she knows she's not hardworking.
DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: Continue
Feel free to look at my collection. I have some real good shinies lined up.
The rich ferryman is back for more, eh? Take what you wanna.
Miss Ferryman is back for more! See anythin' you like?
Answer
Might be a weird question, but do you have any boats?
Tlnote: See the architect conversation 1
DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: Continue
Boats?! Is yours broken or what?
Continue
No, no, it's fine. But the wear and tear is really getting on it. I was wondering if I could find a substitute in here...
Continue
Ah... Sorry, missy, but all I got are some pieces of wood. But I ain't an engineer.
Continue
If only I had a [gold]tsuchigumo[/gold] with me...
Tlnote: In touhou, tsuchigumo (spiders like yamame) are builders.
DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: Hey, do ya know what these flowers I picked up the other day are? Never seen anythin' like 'em in the spire before.
Answer

Oh! These are Spider Lilies!
Hmm... These ones seem to house the souls of the dead.
Tlnote: *These* ones. Not all lilies house spirits. But darv's ones happen to do so.
DARV.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: Continue
The dead live in flowers?!
Continue
Ones that haven't accepted their deaths yet.
Continue
Don't worry. They are harmless. All it means is that they bloom more beautifully.
Continue

They do seem to be on my queue to ferry later though... 
Surely, they can wait!
NEOW.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: I've come to investigate the dead souls here and give them a proper release.
But dear... there are way more than I thought.

[sine]...so... many... dead... 
...but... you... can... give... them... release...[/sine]
You have your own crimes... don't you?
Many are denied death because of you. Their lifespans have extended far beyond what they are supposed to.
I will turn a blind [red]eye[/red] for now, but once the Architect is defeated, you [i]will[/i] be judged for your crimes against the dead.
Tlnote: Red for Shinigami eye.
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMAC: Oh my, a shinigami has come to my domain? I have to say, you are much cuter than what I imagined a reaper would be.

My job isn't to kill. I just ferry the dead.
Can't put the passengers at ease if I looked scary.
How considerate! But what about the scythe? It's got such a peculiar shape to it...
Suprisingly, it helps. One look and they know - "yep, that's a shinigami" - accepting they are dead.
Haha! Then it wouldn't hurt to look more presentable, would it?
Guards, prepare gifts for our esteemed visitor from Hell's [gold]Ministry[/gold] here!
You grace us with your visit, Shinigami!
Say, despite your looks, you are quite wealthy, are you not?
Yet you don't seem to be extravagant with it. Would you like us to find you a new dress?
Oh. That's just because I mostly use my money for danmaku. Gold coins are quite effective blunt bullets.
Tlnote: Might rewrite the above conversation. It's supposed to evoke 'Wow Komachi is so humble with her money. She uses her coins to shoot people? Nvm then'.
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMAC: Shinigami! You're back once again! I got the perfect gift for you!
A crown made out of [red]Spider Lilies[/red]! I know you love these flowers!
Ah, pay it no mind. Guess I've carried these flowers a few too many times myself.
Tlnote: Despite her demeanor, Komachi does care about the dead, and her job does take a mental toll on her. Seeing the flowers associated with them in a beautiful arrangement makes her emotional. See tezcatara's skin deep comment.
OROBAS.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_: Grim Reaper! Awesome Scythe! But no kill!
Don't worry. Despite my look, I don't kill that many people. I just ferry who's already dead to the other side.
Yes. Surprisingly, the dead are quite talkative, and my rides take quite a while. I can tell you some of the stories I've heard.
Orobas! It's good to see you again. Do you want to hear more stories?
Stories! Fun!! But I have concern! Did you do job today?
Wha?! O-of course I did... Why would you think otherwise?
Rumours! They call someone in red a [sine][red]Master of Slacking[/red][/sine]! You [red]red[/red]!
Tlnote: See architect 3-1
OROBAS.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_:
Ahaha... What a funny title... But of course, it doesn't belong to me!
It must be referring to a [red]shrine maiden[/red] in red instead!
Red [red]shrine maiden[/red]? I see! Then I tell shrine maiden about it! She needs to do job!
[i][font_size=18]I need to look out for any stray needles heading my way today...[/font_size][/i]
Tlnote: Reimu's needles.
Repetition is funny.
OROBAS.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_: Of course! You know, you do remind me of a certain [pink]kid[/pink] near the river. Let me tell you about the stones she stacks...
Tlnote: Refers to Eika
PAEL.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: What is this place? It seems so... good to take a nap....
[thinky_dots]A Ferryman? Welcome... You wanted to sleep?[/thinky_dots]
Ah! I wasn't going to nap here!
[thinky_dots]No need to lie... everyone needs repose... Take a part of me, and rest as long as you like...[/thinky_dots]
Really? I like how you think!
[thinky_dots]Ferryman... You are free to slumber for as long as you want...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]You have taken quite a liking to my place, Ferryman...[/thinky_dots]
Already asleep? Very well... Rest as much as you need to...
TANX.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: GRIM REAPER! MIGHTY SCYTHE!! BUT WEIRD EDGE!
People say scythes aren't very practical weapons, but it's good for aesthetics.
Tlnote: Since scythes are farming tools moreso than weapons.
TANX.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_CH: LIES!!! SCYTHES ARE THE DEADLIEST WEAPONS!
FERRYMAN! LET ME SHARPEN YOUR SCYTHE! LET IT CUT AND STAB!
[i][font_size=22]The ferryman fights from a lazy distance[/font_size][/i]
I HAVE NEVER SEEN SUCH AN ELEGANT FIGHTING STYLE!
Tlnote: Despite fighting lazily, tanx sees it as an esoteric fighting style.
TEZCATARA.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMAC: Ooh, a shinigami in the spire? What brought you here, little girlie?
Tlnote: She will use little girlie to refer to komachi for the rest of the dialogue.
TEZCATARA.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMAC: Continue

I'm here to give the dead souls here their rest.
But I might as well have some rest of my own while I'm here.
Continue
Such a [jitter][b]carefree[/b][/jitter] spirit! Why don't I make you something to eat while you slack off?
Continue
Of course! Wait, what did you just say? I'm not slacking off!
Continue
[i][font_size=22]Tezcatara cackles with delight.[/font_size][/i]

Little scythe girlie! I missed you!
I've got [jitter][b]lots[/b][/jitter] prepared for you.
How is the job faring, little girlie? You're not slacking off, are you? [i]cackles[/i]
Excuse
I'm doing it, I'm doing it! It's just, there are so many dead souls that I can't help but take a break, right?
Continue
Of course, sweetie. A job done well is better than a job done hastily.
Continue
I knew you'd get it, granny! The spirits wouldn't like a tired Ferryman greeting them, right?
Continue
So carefree... but that's only [jitter][b]skin deep[/b][/jitter], isn't it?
Tlnote: Komachi's carefree attitude is just a mask for her care.
TEZCATARA.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMAC: Hello, hello, little girlie. Sit down! I've got some good soup for you.
Continue
This soup seems strange... what did you use to make it?
Continue

[jitter][b][red]Spider Lilies[/red][/b][/jitter], of course.
They recently appeared in my garden, and they were so beautiful I had to pick them up.
Continue
What? But they are poisonous!
Continue
For humans, yes. But you are a Shinigami, so it shouldn't be a problem, no?
Continue

Touché...
Hmm, this is actually delicious.
VAKUU.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_C: How fancy, a shinigami from the [gold]Ministry[/gold] has come to me? Ha! How desperate are they?

...
Heya, lord Vakuu! I've heard your contracts grant great power!
Tlnote: ... for short disgusted hesitation before making her response.
VAKUU.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_C: What spiteful eyes behind that smile! I like your act!
Spending a long time reading the fine print with those [red]eyes[/red] of yours, aren'tcha?
How is your pathetic [green]Yama[/green] and her [gold]Ministry[/gold] doing? Need another loan from me?
Tlnote: Implies the ministry of right and wrong has taken a contract from vakuu before.
VAKUU.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_C: [i][font_size=22]Vakuu finds his [jitter][b]neck[/b][/jitter] ogainst the blade of her scythe, the distance between them... [jitter][b]gone[/b][/jitter].[/font_size][/i]
Tlnote: From Vakuu's perspective. It should start with vakuu's neck. Also, usage of distance.
VAKUU.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_C: Now, now, no need to get violent here. Let us make a contract like civilized beings, why don't we?

If it ain't the chipper Ferryman again?
We aren't so different, you know, both of us profiting from the dead.
My job is virtuous, demon. It helps the dead rest.
Tlnote: Eiki tells Komachi that making money for her is virtuous in pofv's extra stage.
VAKUU.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-KOMACHI_C: Whatever helps you sleep on the job.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS_KOMACHI_ONOZUKA-K: A Shinigami come to take my soul?
I'm not here to kill you, but you're killing way too many people! That's making my job way harder than it should be!
You only care about your workload?
Aren't you supposed to do your job?
There are so many souls around here that it's almost impossible to do that!
Could you at least lend me some boats?
I'm not lending you a boat. Go away.
I'm not slacking off! First off, the problem of dead souls is all your fault.
Sounds like an excuse to me.
It's the Master of Slacking again.
What's up with that title? Is there a [red]Shrine Maiden[/red] behind me?
In any case, whatever your experiments are, they aren't my concern.
But your conduct with other people, especially your creations, need a lot of work.
You keep getting 'unwanted' visitors right? That's because your only solution is to kill them, rather than asking why they climbed up in the first place.
Keep letting it drift, and not only will your bad karma pile, but so will the grudges against you. That won't end prettily.
Oops! Seems I caught Eiki's habit...
Unfortunately, I don't have time to be lectured by a lazy Shinigami.
